tagline: General contracting, landscaping & hardscaping across Northeast PA
about_story:
NEPA Classic Construction offers over 30 years of experience in general construction — interior and exterior — landscaping, hardscaping, and much more. We take pride in every project, treating your home as if it were our own.

Serving Scranton, Pittston, Wilkes-Barre, and surrounding communities across Northeastern Pennsylvania, we deliver quality craftsmanship at fair prices. Every project begins with a free estimate — no pressure, no surprises.

services.title: General Contracting
services.short_description: As a fully licensed general contractor based in Northeast Pennsylvania, NEPA Classic Construction manages every detail of your residential or commercial build — from permits and design coordination to subcontractors and final walkthrough.
services.long_description: As a fully licensed general contractor based in Northeast Pennsylvania, NEPA Classic Construction manages every detail of your residential or commercial build — from permits and design coordination to subcontractors and final walkthrough. With over 30 years of experience across Wilkes-Barre, Scranton, and Pittston, we deliver on time and on budget.
benefits: Single point of accountability from start to finish
Trusted local subcontractor network across NEPA
Transparent estimates and milestone-based scheduling
Licensed and insured in Pennsylvania

faqs.q: Do you pull permits?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle all permitting with local Luzerne and Lackawanna County offices.

faqs.q: How long do GC projects take in NEPA?
faqs.a: Timelines vary — small renovations 2–4 weeks, additions 6–12 weeks, new builds 6–9 months.

faqs.q: Whole-home reno timeline?
faqs.a: Typical full renovations in NEPA run 4–8 months depending on size and scope.

faqs.q: Do you handle older home challenges?
faqs.a: Yes — knob-and-tube, plaster, and outdated plumbing are common in NEPA and we handle them.

services.title: Interior Construction
services.short_description: Full interior construction and renovation across Northeast Pennsylvania.
services.long_description: Full interior construction and renovation across Northeast Pennsylvania. Kitchens, bathrooms, basements, and complete interior remodels in Wilkes-Barre, Scranton, Pittston, and surrounding NEPA homes.
benefits: Skilled in-house carpentry, drywall, tile, and trim
Coordinated electrical and plumbing partners
Clean, dust-controlled job sites
Detailed schedules with daily updates

faqs.q: Can we live in the home during work?
faqs.a: Most renovations allow you to stay — we contain work zones and minimize disruption.

faqs.q: Average kitchen timeline?
faqs.a: Typical NEPA kitchen remodels run 4–8 weeks.

services.title: Exterior Construction
services.short_description: Exterior construction across Northeast Pennsylvania — siding, roofing, decks, porches, and structural exterior repairs built for NEPA's weather.
services.long_description: Exterior construction across Northeast Pennsylvania — siding, roofing, decks, porches, and structural exterior repairs built for NEPA's weather. Serving Wilkes-Barre, Scranton, Pittston, and surrounding communities.
benefits: Weather-resistant materials suited for NEPA
Proper flashing and water management
Boosts curb appeal and energy efficiency
Durable, low-maintenance finishes

process.title: Inspection
process.desc: Identify rot, water damage, and structural issues.

faqs.q: When is the best season for exterior work in NEPA?
faqs.a: Late spring through early fall is ideal, though we work year-round when weather permits.

faqs.q: Do you tear off old roofing?
faqs.a: Yes — full tear-off and inspection of decking is our standard.

services.title: Hardscaping
services.short_description: Expert hardscaping in Northeast Pennsylvania — patios, walls, walkways, and stonework built to last through PA winters.
services.long_description: Expert hardscaping in Northeast Pennsylvania — patios, walls, walkways, and stonework built to last through PA winters. Our crews serve Wilkes-Barre, Scranton, Pittston, Kingston, and beyond with precision installation and proper base preparation.
benefits: Engineered base preparation for freeze-thaw durability
Wide selection of pavers, natural stone, and block
Increases usable outdoor living area
Boosts resale value across the NEPA market

faqs.q: Will pavers crack in PA winters?
faqs.a: Properly installed pavers with engineered base last decades through NEPA winters.

faqs.q: Pavers vs. concrete?
faqs.a: Pavers flex with frost heave, are repairable, and outlast poured concrete in our climate.

faqs.q: Patio installation cost?
faqs.a: Most NEPA paver patios run $20–$45 per square foot installed.

faqs.q: How long does it take?
faqs.a: Typical installs are 3–7 days depending on size and features.

faqs.q: Do tall walls need engineering?
faqs.a: Walls over 4 feet typically require engineering and permits in PA — we handle both.

faqs.q: What about drainage?
faqs.a: Every wall we build includes proper gravel backfill and perforated drain pipe.

faqs.q: Pavers strong enough for driveways?
faqs.a: Yes — with proper 8–10 inch compacted base, paver driveways outperform concrete in NEPA.

faqs.q: Do you do snow removal damage repair?
faqs.a: Yes — paver driveways are easily repaired if damaged by plows.

services.title: Landscaping
services.short_description: Professional landscaping services across Northeast Pennsylvania.
services.long_description: Professional landscaping services across Northeast Pennsylvania. From design to installation, we transform yards in Scranton, Wilkes-Barre, Kingston, and surrounding areas with plantings, grading, sod, and complete outdoor environments built for NEPA's climate.
benefits: Custom landscape design tailored to your property
Native and climate-appropriate plantings for NEPA
Proper grading and drainage solutions
Increases curb appeal and property value

process.title: Plant selection
process.desc: Hardy species suited to PA winters.

process.title: Installation
process.desc: Bed prep, planting, mulching, and finishing.

faqs.q: Best time to landscape in NEPA?
faqs.a: Spring (April–June) and early fall (September–October) are ideal in Northeast Pennsylvania.

faqs.q: Do you offer maintenance?
faqs.a: We focus on design and installation; we can recommend trusted local maintenance partners.

faqs.q: What areas do you serve in Northeast Pennsylvania?
faqs.a: NEPA Classic Construction proudly serves Wilkes-Barre, Scranton, Pittston, Kingston, Nanticoke, Dallas, Plains, and surrounding communities throughout Luzerne and Lackawanna Counties.

faqs.q: Do you offer free estimates?
faqs.a: Yes — every project starts with a free, no-obligation estimate. Call (570) 479-1318 or fill out our contact form to schedule yours.

faqs.q: How much does landscaping cost in Northeast Pennsylvania?
faqs.a: Landscaping costs vary depending on scope, materials, and site conditions. Most residential projects in NEPA range from $3,000 to $25,000+. We provide a detailed, itemized estimate so you know exactly what you're paying for.

faqs.q: How long does a patio installation take?
faqs.a: A typical paver patio installation in NEPA takes 3–7 days, depending on size, base preparation, and weather. Larger projects with retaining walls or built-in features can take 2–3 weeks.

faqs.q: What types of hardscaping do you install?
faqs.a: We install paver patios, retaining walls, walkways, driveways, fire pits, outdoor kitchens, steps, and stone veneer across Wilkes-Barre, Scranton, Pittston, and the rest of NEPA.

faqs.q: Are you licensed and insured in Pennsylvania?
faqs.a: Yes. NEPA Classic Construction is a fully licensed and insured Pennsylvania contractor with over 30 years of experience.

faqs.q: Do you handle interior renovations as well as exterior work?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We're a full-service general contractor offering interior renovations (kitchens, bathrooms, basements) and exterior construction (siding, roofing, decks, porches) across Northeast Pennsylvania.
